# baffinbay_traffic_config (Resource)

Manages a Baffin Bay Traffic Configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the traffic configuration.
- `type` (String) The type of traffic configuration (l4Proxy, routedDsr, httpProxy).

### Optional

- `deployment_state` (String) The deployment state (DEPLOYED, UNDEPLOYED).
- `frontend_port` (Number) The frontend port. (L4 Proxy)
- `prefix` (String) The CIDR prefix. (Routed DSR)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the traffic configuration.
